run_detection_job_on_cluster: run the detection transformer training job on a Slurm cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_detection_training_with_autoexecu: submit a multi-node detection training job using submitit AutoExecutor with GPU and memory parameters
create_trainer_for_detection_job: create a Trainer instance that wraps detection arguments and handles GPU setup and checkpointing
checkpoint_trainer_for_requeuing: checkpoint the Trainer to requeue a detection job with resume support via DelayedSubmission
setup_gpu_args_from_job_env: setup GPU arguments from the submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world size, and output directory
